## 2. Technical Stack & Capabilities

### Core Languages
- **TypeScript**: Strict type systems, generics, interface modeling, utility types.
- **JavaScript (ES6+)**: Async/await, closures, functional programming, DOM performance, event delegation.
- **HTML5 & CSS3**: Semantic document outlines, WCAG accessibility, CSS custom properties, responsive breakpoints.
- **Python**: Scripting, data automation, foundational algorithms.
- **Dart**: Cross-platform mobile development with Flutter.

### Frontend Technologies
- **Next.js (App Router)**: Server Components (RSC), Client Components, Server Actions, Dynamic Route Handlers, Streaming SSR, Image Optimization, Edge Middleware.
- **React 18 / 19**: Custom hooks, context providers, concurrent rendering features, state reduction.
- **Tailwind CSS**: Utility-first styling, design system tokens, CSS containment, dark mode theming.
- **Motion & Interaction Libraries**:
  - **Framer Motion**: Gesture physics, layout animations, spring curves, AnimatePresence transitions.
  - **GSAP (GreenSock)**: Timeline orchestrations, ScrollTrigger sequences, high-performance canvas/DOM tweening.
  - **Three.js & React Three Fiber (R3F)**: 3D scene composition, shader materials, lighting, GLTF model loading, and hardware-accelerated rendering.

### Backend & Databases
- **Node.js**: Asynchronous event-driven runtimes, RESTful API architecture.
- **Express.js**: Middleware pipelines, routing, authentication mechanisms.
- **MongoDB & Mongoose**: Document schema modeling, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies.
- **PostgreSQL**: Relational schemas, ACID transactions, relational queries.
- **Authentication**: JWT token cycles, secure cookie sessions.

### Mobile & System Design
- **Flutter**: Declarative widget UI, responsive layouts, cross-platform deployment.
- **Design Systems**: Apple Human Interface Guidelines fidelity (macOS and iOS 17/18 control centers, dynamic islands, haptic springs).

### Project 1: URL Memory
- **URL**: https://memory.jenixweblancer.in/
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Core Stack**: Next.js App Router, React, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Server Actions
- **Key Features**:
  - URL shortening with sub-millisecond custom redirection.
  - Real-time click tracking, geolocation analytics, and browser referrer metrics.
  - User authentication and link lifecycle management.
  - Responsive dark-mode dashboard with instantaneous visual feedback.

### Project 2: Movie Rating Explorer
- **URL**: https://entertainment-gold.vercel.app/
- **Role**: Frontend Engineer
- **Core Stack**: React 18, TMDB REST API, Tailwind CSS, Debounced State Hooks
- **Key Features**:
  - Live search debounced at 300ms against the TMDB database.
  - Category, genre, and rating filters that update without full-page reloads.
  - Responsive poster grids with lazy image loading and skeleton fallbacks.

### Project 3: Expense Tracker
- **URL**: https://expense-tracker-ircf.vercel.app/
- **Role**: Full-Stack Engineer
- **Core Stack**: React, Chart.js, Tailwind CSS, State Management
- **Key Features**:

  - Local state persistence and CSV export functionality.

### Project 4: AI Conversation Interface Prototype

## 4. Architectural Philosophy & Code Quality

1. **Performance First**:
   - Zero-bloat bundle management: selective tree-shaking and dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`) for heavy libraries.
   - Core Web Vitals optimization: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 1.8s, Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) near 0.
   - Adaptive rendering: mobile devices bypass heavy 3D WebGL scenes to maximize battery efficiency and framerates (60-120fps).

2. **Accessibility & Semantics**:
   - Semantic HTML outlines (`header`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`, `nav`).
   - Screen-reader accessible attributes (`aria-label`, `role="slider"`, `tabIndex`).
   - Contrast ratios adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA standards.

3. **Motion Design with Purpose**:
   - Physics-based spring animations that mirror tactile physical reality.
   - Avoidance of gratuitous decorative animations; every motion conveys state change or affordance.
